person.label: Person
person.boundary: An individual; CEO and partner are roles, not person subtypes.

animal.label: Animal
animal.boundary: An individually meaningful animal, not a species.

organization.label: Organization
organization.boundary: A company or formal/informal group; separate from its premises.

place.label: Place
place.boundary: A geographic or physical location; not the business occupying it.

project.label: Project
project.boundary: A bounded initiative; executable tasks remain Turn Engine records.

event.label: Event
event.boundary: An occasion; distinguish recurring series from occurrences.

activity.label: Activity
activity.boundary: An activity or interest, not a scheduled occurrence.

topic.label: Topic
topic.boundary: A subject or field; interest does not establish expertise.

goal.label: Goal
goal.boundary: A desired outcome, potentially motivating several projects.

routine.label: Routine
routine.boundary: A repeatable pattern or workflow, not an execution instance.

asset.label: Asset
asset.boundary: A product or possession; distinguish model from owned instance.

service.label: Service
service.boundary: An offering, separate from provider or executed transaction.

content.label: Content
content.boundary: A document, book, film, or other identifiable content.

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.boundary: An account or communication address; memory never establishes verification or holds credentials.

task.label: TaskReference
task.boundary: Reference only; never infer operational completion from memory.

decision.label: DecisionReference
decision.boundary: Reference only; approvals and transitions belong to the Turn Engine.

transaction.label: TransactionReference
transaction.boundary: Reference only; provider evidence determines booking/payment outcomes.

interaction.label: InteractionReference
interaction.boundary: Reference only; stable threads and discrete interactions are distinct records.

fact.label: Fact
fact.boundary: Created through the facts collection with evidence, subject, and time; not as a freestanding entity.

expansion.unknown_predicate: retain sourced assertion with classification_status=pending; do not silently add an approved definition
expansion.identity: never merge on name or phonetics alone
expansion.authority: new vocabulary cannot confer permissions, verification, or execution authority
